# Elsevier
> Elsevier provides advanced information, analytics, and decision-support solutions for researchers, clinicians, educators, and institutions worldwide.

Elsevier combines scientific publishing, research intelligence, clinical decision support, and education technologies across science and healthcare. Its website spans journals, books, databases, author services, APIs, product documentation, and corporate resources.

## Research Platforms and Databases
- [ScienceDirect](https://www.elsevier.com/products/sciencedirect): Full-text platform for peer-reviewed journals, books, and reference works.
- [Scopus](https://www.elsevier.com/products/scopus): Abstract and citation database for research discovery, analysis, and tracking.
- [SciVal](https://www.elsevier.com/products/scival): Research performance analytics for benchmarking, collaboration, and strategic planning.
- [Embase](https://www.elsevier.com/products/embase): Biomedical database for literature searching, pharmacovigilance, and evidence generation.
- [Reaxys](https://www.elsevier.com/products/reaxys): Chemistry database for substances, reactions, properties, and synthesis planning.
- [Mendeley](https://www.elsevier.com/products/mendeley): Reference management and academic collaboration tools for researchers.
- [Digital Commons](https://www.elsevier.com/products/digital-commons): Institutional repository and publishing platform for universities and libraries.

## Clinical and Healthcare Solutions
- [ClinicalKey](https://www.elsevier.com/products/clinicalkey): Clinical decision support with books, journals, guidelines, and multimedia content.
- [ClinicalKey AI](https://www.elsevier.com/products/clinicalkey/clinicalkey-ai): Generative AI assistant for evidence-based clinical information retrieval.
- [Clinical Pharmacology](https://www.elsevier.com/products/clinical-pharmacology): Drug reference and medication decision support for clinicians and pharmacists.
- [Complete Anatomy](https://www.elsevier.com/products/complete-anatomy): Interactive 3D anatomy platform for teaching, learning, and patient education.
- [Osmosis](https://www.elsevier.com/products/osmosis): Medical education platform with videos, questions, and learning tools.
- [STATdx](https://www.elsevier.com/products/statdx): Diagnostic decision support for radiology and imaging specialists.
- [Pathway Studio](https://www.elsevier.com/products/pathway-studio): Biological pathway analysis and literature-based discovery for life sciences.

## Journals, Books, and Content Collections
- [Journals](https://www.elsevier.com/products/journals): Browse Elsevier’s journal portfolio across scientific and medical disciplines.
- [Books and eBooks](https://www.elsevier.com/products/books-and-ebooks): Discover textbooks, professional books, and digital reference content.
- [Article Collections](https://www.elsevier.com/about/open-science/article-collections): Curated collections supporting topical research and open science initiatives.
- [Clinical eBooks](https://www.elsevier.com/products/clinicalkey): Clinical book content available through Elsevier healthcare platforms.
- [Reference Works](https://www.elsevier.com/products/sciencedirect): Major reference content accessible through ScienceDirect.

## Authors and Publishing Support
- [For Authors](https://www.elsevier.com/authors): Author guidance for preparing, submitting, and publishing manuscripts.
- [Find a Journal](https://www.elsevier.com/authors/tools-and-resources/find-a-journal): Journal selection tool for matching manuscripts to suitable titles.
- [Author Services](https://www.elsevier.com/authors/author-services): Editing, illustration, translation, and publication support services.
- [Researcher Academy](https://www.elsevier.com/researcheracademy): Free learning platform covering publishing, peer review, and research skills.
- [Open Access](https://www.elsevier.com/open-access): Open access publishing options, policies, and funding information.
- [Publishing Ethics](https://www.elsevier.com/about/policies-and-standards/publishing-ethics): Policies and guidance on ethics, integrity, and responsible publishing.
- [Copyright](https://www.elsevier.com/about/policies-and-standards/copyright): Copyright policies, permissions, and reuse guidance for Elsevier content.

## Editors and Reviewers
- [For Editors](https://www.elsevier.com/editors): Resources and guidance for journal editors working with Elsevier.
- [For Reviewers](https://www.elsevier.com/reviewers): Peer review guidance, training, and recognition information for reviewers.
- [Editorial Manager](https://www.editorialmanager.com): Manuscript submission and peer review system used by many Elsevier journals.
- [Reviewer Hub](https://www.elsevier.com/reviewers/how-to-review): Practical guidance on conducting high-quality peer review.
- [Ethics in Research and Publication](https://www.elsevier.com/about/policies-and-standards/publishing-ethics): Standards for editors, reviewers, and authors across the publishing workflow.

## APIs, Integrations, and Developer Resources
- [Elsevier Developer Portal](https://dev.elsevier.com): API documentation and access for search, metadata, and content services.
- [Scopus APIs](https://dev.elsevier.com/sc_apis.html): APIs for Scopus search, abstracts, citations, and author data.
- [ScienceDirect APIs](https://dev.elsevier.com/sd_apis.html): APIs for article metadata, abstracts, and content retrieval.
- [Serial Title API](https://dev.elsevier.com/tecdoc_sd_ir_02.html): API documentation for serial title and journal metadata access.
- [API Key Registration](https://dev.elsevier.com/apikey/manage): Manage API keys and developer account access.
- [API Documentation Home](https://dev.elsevier.com/documentation): Central documentation for Elsevier APIs and technical integration.

## Open Science, Policies, and Standards
- [Open Science](https://www.elsevier.com/about/open-science): Elsevier’s open science programs, principles, and supporting resources.
- [Policies and Standards](https://www.elsevier.com/about/policies-and-standards): Corporate and publishing policies covering ethics, privacy, and compliance.
- [Inclusive Language and Reporting](https://www.elsevier.com/authors/policies-and-guidelines/inclusive-language): Guidance for inclusive, respectful, and accurate scholarly writing.
- [Research Data](https://www.elsevier.com/authors/tools-and-resources/research-data): Data sharing guidance, repositories, and data statement support.
- [Responsible AI Principles](https://www.elsevier.com/about/policies-and-standards/responsible-ai-principles): Principles guiding Elsevier’s development and use of AI technologies.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.elsevier.com/legal/privacy-policy): Privacy practices for Elsevier websites, products, and services.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://www.elsevier.com/legal/elsevier-website-terms-and-conditions): Terms governing use of Elsevier websites and online services.

## Solutions by Audience and Sector
- [Academic and Government](https://www.elsevier.com/academic-and-government): Solutions for universities, libraries, funders, and public-sector research organizations.
- [Health](https://www.elsevier.com/health): Clinical and educational solutions for healthcare professionals and institutions.
- [Industry](https://www.elsevier.com/industry): Information and analytics solutions for R&D-intensive industries and enterprises.
- [Life Sciences](https://www.elsevier.com/industry/life-sciences): Solutions supporting drug discovery, medical affairs, and regulatory workflows.
- [Research Leaders](https://www.elsevier.com/academic-and-government/research-leaders): Tools and insights for institutional strategy and research management.
- [Librarians](https://www.elsevier.com/librarians): Resources for collection development, access, and library partnerships.

## Support, Training, and Learning
- [Support Center](https://service.elsevier.com): Help center for product support, account issues, and common questions.
- [Mendeley Support](https://service.elsevier.com/app/home/supporthub/mendeley): Support resources for Mendeley users and administrators.
- [ScienceDirect Support](https://service.elsevier.com/app/home/supporthub/sciencedirect): Help and troubleshooting for ScienceDirect access and usage.
- [Scopus Support](https://service.elsevier.com/app/home/supporthub/scopus): Support articles and contact options for Scopus users.
- [ClinicalKey Support](https://service.elsevier.com/app/home/supporthub/clinicalkey): Product help and account support for ClinicalKey customers.
- [Researcher Academy](https://www.elsevier.com/researcheracademy): Training modules for publishing, communication, and career development.

## Company, News, and Careers
- [About Elsevier](https://www.elsevier.com/about): Company overview, mission, leadership, and strategic priorities.
- [News](https://www.elsevier.com/about/press-releases): Press releases and company announcements from Elsevier.
- [Insights](https://www.elsevier.com/connect): Articles and commentary on research, publishing, and healthcare trends.
- [Careers](https://www.elsevier.com/careers): Career opportunities and information about working at Elsevier.
- [Sustainability](https://www.elsevier.com/about/sustainability): Sustainability commitments, reporting, and environmental initiatives.
- [Contact Us](https://www.elsevier.com/contact): Contact options for sales, support, and corporate inquiries.
